bundle: OASIS-CARLA G3.2 Domain Policy Bundle v1

controller_implementation_values.note: low-level actuation coefficients only; they are not OASIS memory/participation/reconstruction semantic thresholds

fixed_scientific_boundaries: authoritative current tau is supplied by host flow and never inferred from epoch
relation participation operator receives no tau, age, recency or completion timestamp
unmeasured reconstruction distribution effect is null, not numeric zero
responsibility remains U/I/V/T vector and is not collapsed to one score
choice uses Pareto non-domination before current possibility distribution
actuation operator has no memory/provenance input
relation-process closure has no universal timeout/distance/frame threshold
multi-source reconstruction requires a matching joint ablation probe
